use_cases: Hero section backgrounds for SaaS landing pages requiring subtle animated visuals
Brand showcase areas needing sophisticated flowing texture effects
Portfolio or creative tool interfaces seeking elegant dark backgrounds
Product landing pages requiring premium visual polish without heavy assets
Full-screen section dividers with continuous ambient animation
ai_summary: A canvas-based animated background component that generates flowing silk-like patterns using procedural noise and trigonometric functions on a dark gradient substrate. Features responsive sizing, smooth continuous animation, and creates a premium visual texture suitable for hero sections and landing pages in SaaS, media, and creative tool applications.
